extracted.intended_audience: readers of cultural/television criticism and fans of late-night comedy
extracted.subtask_description: Opinion/critical evaluation of a late-night talk show host's comedic performance and on-stage persona. Focuses on qualities of delivery, stage manner, material coherence, and comic energy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delivery, timing, and punchlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Never improved his delivery, timing or punchlines in the decade plus he hosted Late Night.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strength in a talk-show comedian is measured by clear delivery, sharp timing, and effective punchlines; failure to improve these over time is a notable flaw.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stage manner (presence) versus style
rubrics_metrics.description: There was an unsettling, not endearing nervousness about the man's manner (as opposed to style) in front of an audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stage manner should inspire confidence or warmth; visible nervousness or an unsettling manner undermines the comedian's appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Naturalness of ad-libs
rubrics_metrics.description: At his best, he seemed like he was rehearsing his ad libs in front of the bathroom mirror.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ad-libs should feel spontaneous and natural; material or improvisation that reads as rehearsed weakens comedic authenticity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Physical composure and facial/eye behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: At his worst he looked painfully ill-at-ease, often times casting a sidelong glance that made him appear like a rushing pedestrian trying to catch his profile in a store window.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid awkward physical ticks, sidelong glances, or other gestures that convey discomfort; physical composure and appropriate eye contact support comedic performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topic coherence (clarity of material)
rubrics_metrics.description: His topics conflate with one another like unruly schools of fish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comedic bits should maintain topical coherence; conflating subjects or jumping without clear links confuses the audience and dilutes jokes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoidance of visible anxiety/twitchy delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: He breaks out in flop sweat... his tongue seems to swell, his twitchy delivery is one click away from a sobbing breakdown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signs of anxiety (flop sweat, twitchiness, speech problems) are anti-patterns — they distract from jokes and signal lack of stage control.

rubrics_metrics.name: Energy and vitality of humor
rubrics_metrics.description: Rush past this over paid stiff's limp humor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Humor should have energy and sparkle; 'limp' or flat delivery/material fails to engage and is judged negatively.
